scenes.title: Why chips led the market
scenes.narration: Here is the chain behind the move. It started with Nvidia's first-quarter beat. That beat reinforced confidence in AI infrastructure spending. Confidence spilled over to related chip names like AMD and Broadcom. The result was a tech-led rally, with the Nasdaq-100 ETF up 1.12%. One risk to watch: rates remain elevated.

scenes.title: Who disclosed trades
scenes.narration: Public filings show 7 Congressional purchases of Nvidia in the last 30 days. AMD's chief executive, Lisa Su, bought shares on the open market. Remember that these filings are delayed by 30 to 45 days.
scenes.warning: STOCK Act filings carry 30–45 day delay — these transactions may not reflect current positions.

scenes.title: The number to watch
scenes.narration: The 10-year Treasury yield sits at 4.28%. Higher yields make future earnings worth less today, which tends to weigh on growth stocks.
